title: Proleptic
summary: PROLEP'TIC PROLEP'TICAL, adjective Pertaining to prolepsis or anticipation. 1. Previous; antecedent. 2. In medicine, anticipating the usual time; applied to a periodical disease, whose paroxysm return

inlines.v: PROLEP'TIC PROLEP'TICAL, adjective Pertaining to prolepsis or anticipation. 1. Previous; antecedent. 2. In medicine, anticipating the usual time; applied to a periodical disease, whose paroxysm returns at an earlier hour at every repetition.
